title: Austin Officials Discuss Appointments Privately
summary:
*   The special meeting's primary focus was to consider potential appointments to various positions.
*   Officials immediately moved into a closed executive session for confidential discussions related to these appointments.
*   Any final decisions or votes regarding the appointments were slated to occur in a public, open session following the private discussions.

MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
April 18, 1974
10:30 A.M.
Mayor's Office
Municipal Building
124 West 8th Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Butler presiding. Roll Call: Present:
Councilman Binder, Friedman, Handcox, Lebermann, Mayor
Butler, Mayor Pro Tern Love
Absent:
Councilman Dry-den
The Mayor announced that this was a Special Called Meeting of the City Council for the
purpose of considering appointments, and to announce publicly during the Meeting it would
convene in a closed or executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraph (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed or executive
session any final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter considered in the
closed or executive session shall be made in open session, should such action, decision or
vote be necessary.
The Mayor announced that the Council would go into executive session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraph (g) of Article 6252-17.
